description: Open a URL / deep link on the device to jump straight to a screen — useful for testing your app's deep-link routes (e.g. myapp://product/42). If the scheme isn't registered in the app under test, the result carries an actionable message explaining the app needs a rebuild to pick up the scheme.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

url.description: URL / deep link to open, e.g. myapp://product/42

name: screen_open_url
